description: This file implements the FastbootConfigFlag class, which manages the fastboot configuration flag within the cuttlefish project. It defines the class, its methods for processing flags, generating help XML, and provides a component for dependency injection.

classes.name: FastbootConfigFlagImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the FastbootConfigFlag interface, handling flag processing, dependencies, and help XML generation.

methods.name: FastbootConfigFlagImpl
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for FastbootConfig and ConfigFlag.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the flag implementation.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for this flag, specifically the ConfigFlag.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments to set the proxy fastboot configuration.

methods.name: WriteGflagsCompatHelpXml
methods.description: Generates help XML for the flag.
